verdict.rationale: Self-hosting the engine is well documented: a single dependency-free binary for Linux/macOS/Windows, installable via cURL, Docker, Homebrew, APT, source, or Helm on Kubernetes, with production guidance. Community reports confirm it running in production on Hetzner, k8s and Coolify at scale. However, nothing in the evidence confirms feature parity with the hosted product. Cloud and pricing pages advertise native read-HA clustering, analytics, personalization and dynamic search rules, and none of these are shown to be available self-hosted. missing for 10: documented feature parity between self-hosted and Cloud, self-hosted HA/clustering, confirmation that analytics/personalization/dynamic search rules work self-hosted.
